title: Research: P104 two-target correction needs exactly 78 helper lifetimes
body:
## Result and scope

PR2393's two-target source-sharing handoff now has an exact answer for **P104 Y0 and Y1: 78 new helper lifetimes are necessary and sufficient** in its fixed-source-path, X-only monotone relay model. The two correction supports have 48 entries each and share 18. A reversible two-total basis in their common frame lets those 18 source acquisitions serve both targets, with all arbitrary dirty inputs restored.

This adds only `research/p104-two-target-sharing/`: a written proof, literal circuit, source-bound receipt, a separately implemented mathematical audit, and a checked no-sharing comparison. Contribution head `6def43ad673b91dbd491389964d1dcd059bf2ac2`; scientific base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`.

| Added quantity | Shared construction | Literal independent-entry comparison |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Helper lifetimes | **78** | 96 |
| ZERO-to-FULL boundary rank mass | **702** | 864 |
| Scalar ADDs | 440 | **384** |
| Nested transports | **236** | 288 |
| Source reads | **156** | 192 |

The shared word saves 18 helper lifetimes and 162 boundary rank units, while using 56 more scalar additions. Its added profile is `142 H1 + 16 H2 + 18 H6 + 60 H7`. The full partial channel has 4,734 events and 358 independent input columns. Y0/Y1 finish as identity transfers; the other 102 target rows keep the original G/2 channel. All original and added dirty helper logical values restore.

The lower bound is a written arbitrary-length dependence-path argument, with all 96 required source/target escape premises checked exactly. Rank-mass sharpness additionally requires every new lifetime to run ZERO to FULL with dimension-gap billing. It is neither a simultaneous physical-stock lower bound nor an excess-cost invoice. The particular ADD count and histogram are not asserted optimal.

**No full supplier or new kappa.** Native phases/new scalar-address lowering, reverse-orientation admission, global owners and idle/residual children, the other 102 corrections, physical precision/tape and all-size admission remain open. The original channel's native proof does not admit these new transports automatically. The exact ideal logical prefix l1 maximum 106 and denominator 4 are not a roundoff proof. Selected/frontier records and frozen predecessor sources are unchanged.

## Verification

On CPython 3.12, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-target-sharing
make selected-record-check
```

Both pass. Registered replay checks sparse Fraction and separate dense dyadic integer implementations, all 128,164 endpoint coefficients, the original 280-column channel, the 376-column comparison,11 primary and7 independent rejecting controls, equivalent-basis positive controls, and both complete regenerated JSON payloads. Seven behavioral groups cover read-only Git-free execution, missing/changed evidence, source drift, malformed JSON, exclusive output, and sensitivity to deliberately removing the endpoint predicate. Final package bytes were replayed after formatting the literal events for review. Hosted CI is separate and not claimed passed.
